files.purpose: Declares the caseless enum MCPPaths, the single place that fixes where every MCP-related file lives on disk: the mcp/ subdirectory of Storage.root (created with intermediate directories, errors swallowed by try?, on first access of the lazily initialised static), the two settings files mcp.json and custom-mcp.json directly under Storage.root, and the three per-provider launch config files claude.json, codex.json and copilot.json inside mcp/. In B3 this is a new file only because commit d70cff8fe ('layer rules restored') moved the enum, byte for byte, out of DroppyCode/Core/Models/MCP.swift (B2 lines 234-253) into the Services layer, since it depends on Storage.root (DroppyCode/Services/Store/Storage.swift:19, now StoragePaths.root).
key_symbols: static let directory: URL (Storage.root/"mcp", isDirectory: true; FileManager.default.createDirectory(at:withIntermediateDirectories: true) under try?) :6-10
calls_into: Storage.root (DroppyCode/Services/Store/Storage.swift:19, which B3 defines as StoragePaths.root from DroppyCode/Core/Support/StoragePaths.swift)
state_owned: Process-wide lazily initialised static URLs: directory (evaluated once, with its mkdir side effect), connectionsURL, customsURL, claudeConfigURL, codexConfigURL, copilotConfigURL
side_effects: First access of MCPPaths.directory (directly, or through claudeConfigURL/codexConfigURL/copilotConfigURL) creates <Storage.root>/mcp/ with intermediate directories; any failure is swallowed by try? and the URL is still returned
platform_assumptions: Storage.root is the macOS Application Support data root; paths are file URLs built with appendingPathComponent
persisted_fields: <Storage.root>/mcp.json: [MCPConnection] as JSON (comment :12 'Kept for the Keychain-free settings')
<Storage.root>/custom-mcp.json: [MCPCustomServer] as JSON, secret values never stored there (comment :14)
feature_notes: B2->B3: file is status A (22 insertions) but its content is a pure relocation. Verified with diff: B3 MCPPaths.swift lines 3-22 are byte-identical to B2 DroppyCode/Core/Models/MCP.swift lines 234-253 (doc comment + enum); B3 only adds `import Foundation` (line 1) and a blank line (2). The same B2->B3 diff deletes exactly that block from Core/Models/MCP.swift (hunk @@ -231,27 +209,6 @@). Line mapping: B3 line = B2 MCP.swift line - 231 (e.g. :236-253 -> :5-22, :238 -> :7, :244 -> :13, :246 -> :15).

No observable behaviour changed: same directory name 'mcp', same file names mcp.json, custom-mcp.json, claude.json, codex.json, copilot.json, same placement (the two settings files at the root, NOT inside mcp/), same try? mkdir-on-first-access semantics.

Why it moved (SOURCE FACT, commit d70cff8fe subject 'refactor: audit cleanups ... layer rules restored'): MCPPaths depends on Storage.root, a Services type, so it could not stay in Core under the AGENTS.md layering rule. The Windows port had already made the same move for the same reason (ED-177, src/Marrow.Services/Models/MCP.cs).

B3 callers of MCPPaths (grep): MCPExternalSync.swift:52 (managed.json), MCPHub.swift:127, MCPProviderConfig.swift:78,150,155-157,200,213-214,218,230 (gemini-settings.json), MCPProxy.swift:17 (proxy-port), MCPSessionOverrides.swift:33, MCPStore.swift:5,7,240,244,262,269, CommandCodeSession.swift:163,177-178, PiSession.swift:109-110. Several of these lines shifted from B2 (e.g. geminiSettingsURL 238->230, portFile 15->17), which belongs to those files' bundles.
